recipe.name: Saurian — beaded skin / Delft clay
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Imported-stock master, one reptile skin from face to palm: pointed, keeled scutes the width of the band, graded from the face down both shoulders, and small round scales on the head's walls. Every wall faces round the ring or away from the parting line, so the skin pulls as drawn. Z=0 parting, opposed Z withdrawal. The stone is flush set at the bench: drill on the raised mark at the face's centre, cut the seat to the measured stone, burnish. Polish the reserved rims and the palm; leave the grooves satin.
